contracts.docstring: Fresh owner instruction with an exact optional prior-code input selection, never inherited approval.
Observed original attempt and packet fingerprint shared by Tasks and Conversation admissions.
Translate the validated selection to the runtime's neutral typed contract.
Preserve the original explanatory instruction and optional observed prior code in one native admission receipt.
Original owner request with optional observed prior code as attributed data.
Start fresh native work with an exact optional earlier candidate selection; never transfer its approval.
Inspect retained original native input and exact diff without resuming, editing or accepting it.
Render exact complete input deterministically so owner observations and retries identify the same material.
Owner-observed original candidate and complete input fingerprint, never a moving path or branch.
Reject ambiguous identities before admission or receipt lookup.
Read retained original bytes and freeze owner-selected data using the existing admission receipt transaction.
Reuse the run store; construction starts no process or additional controller.
Require an actual closed native author and its saved complete input; do not reconstruct unknown history.
Expose the exact retained candidate data without resuming it, editing files or accepting work.
Bind the exact owner observation and same registered source to a fresh development admission.
Read the original atomic admission receipt, independent of later source state and candidate files.

Own one native thread/connection; serialize turns and correlate control.

The product service must persist context/attempt identity and aggregate
budgets across process restarts. Interrupted sessions retire their connection;
further work must reopen the durable native thread. This class does not decide
whether a correction was applied, an artifact accepted, or a task done.
Run one bounded turn; a completed scoped host response counts as progress while model chatter and pending decisions do not.
Freeze complete original task/history and typed prerequisite delivery; reject oversize material without hidden omission.
Own native attempts and grant-bound tool closure before durable terminal states.
Admit one original owner request, optionally retaining observed prior code as data or a separate finding-review target.
Own durable admission, fenced attempts and version-bound review requests in SQLite.
Keep historical ordinary intents stable and bind exact review or earlier-code input selections.
Recover original admission receipts without rechecking or replaying effects.
Read an exact ordinary or review request receipt without scheduling work.
Return the durable receipt for one scoped admission, freezing a review target when supplied.
Admit a typed author or bound independent finding review without reinterpreting historical receipts.
Exercise private edits, durable job reads and fresh Ken reads without proposing research acceptance.
Consume actual delivered prior bytes when selected; the controlled fresh author applies them with Git in its private copy.
Generate controlled independent review calls; every source/proposal/Git/closure operation remains production code.
Select exact observed data after explicit original withdrawal; storage witnesses are synthetic.
Dropping prior-code admission binding would lose exact bytes on reload or silently change a retried intent.
Reconstructing the original request from current task state would erase what the old author actually saw.
Neither a selected label nor an old preview can authorize foreign input or bypass original native closure.
Historic unrecorded input remains unknown; it is not a verified native carryover packet.
Ignoring the selected target at either public entry would silently start unrelated work after reload or response loss.
A legally large frozen conversation must not be shortened silently to make prior material fit.
Ignoring completed host requests would abort useful tool work despite its bounded successful response.
Finish a real awaited host decision after the model-idle allowance, within the absolute wall limit.
Fresh authoring and explicit prior-code reuse keep original receipts, independent checks/review and an unchanged source.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
